prior_summary: Successor-aware short-horizon diffusion selection. A full-state diffusion proposal has three learned paired epsilon/clean-action refinements. A separately supervised three-member recurrent dynamics ensemble predicts eight-action consequences and opening, release/retreat and red-lift readiness. Within-denoising soft selection prefers demonstration-like predicted consequences with less disagreement, opening loss and stage-inappropriate coupling. A differentiable training consequence loss also teaches the epsilon proposal through frozen dynamics. This is an explicit adaptation of completed-chunk reranking to the fixed epsilon-only deployment interface, not an external planner.
applicable_conditions: Accurate causal world-frame qpos/qvel, TCP and object poses, drawer displacement and velocity, and goals under demonstrated dynamics. Train support covers initial rest and the full expanded approach, handle grasp/pull, release/retreat, red approach, closure and initial lift. Partial-transition takeover is supported by geometry, finger opening, observed articulation and two-observation motion; failed grasps, jams and collisions are not supported.
termination_guidance: The API can transfer actual observed state/history to evacuate_red during supported partial pulling or later release and acquisition. Drawer position above 0.26 m alone is not evidence of handle release or red pickup. The expanded exit is near d=0.300 m with red rising toward z=0.143 m, each finger about 0.0182 m and close command -1. Continue this model through supported local transition motion if a later handoff is desired, rather than waiting for a mandatory static hold. Do not use advisory predicted readiness as a switching predicate or redefine the supplied whole-task success contract.
limitations: No post-sampling hook exists: three paired refinements are ranked inside each epsilon evaluation, not three independent complete DDPM chains. Companion clean predictions, unit-variance demonstration-density proxy, stage weights and ensemble disagreement are approximate and unvalidated. Candidate collapse and common model bias are possible. Dynamics see only successful action neighborhoods. No collision, force, contact, IK, safety or jam-recovery guarantee; no observation-only penalty is presented as a learning signal. No performance feedback was used in design.

config.architecture: Shared Conditional U-Net, causal full-state encoder, three bounded epsilon-refinement/clean-companion heads, causal imitation anchor, three recurrent action-conditioned residual dynamics models
config.normalization: Unmodified complete-demonstration shared range normalizer from spec; no skill-specific fit
config.rollout_action_slots_convention: Start inclusive, stop exclusive. Slot zero ends at the current observation and is not re-executed in the model rollout.
config.density_proxy: Causal learned normalized-action mean, unit-variance isotropic Gaussian squared-distance proxy; not true DDPM likelihood
config.generated_auxiliary_reliability: alpha_bar squared; predicted x0 clipped to normalized action bounds; dynamics parameters detached, action gradients retained
config.segmentation: Unchanged full assigned slices: start 0; stop 475 for demo1000,1002,1003,1004,1006,1009,1010,1011; stop 476 for demo1001; stop 474 for demo1005,1007,1008. No restriction to the overlap or core pull phase.
config.ablation_guidance: Scientific comparison should disable energy-based weighting and generated-action consequence/selection auxiliaries while retaining the same diffusion proposal, budget and data. No such performance comparison is claimed here.
